pages.title: Demonic Partner
pages.text: Magicians practicing the occult are a diverse crowd, coming from all creeds and all corners of the world. However one thing unites them all - they are as lonely as any human without a partner.$(br2)Of course being a magician, the $()

pages.title: Demonic Partner
pages.text: dating pool is larger than for most people, meeting all kinds of otherworldly beings, besides humans.$(br)

pages.title: Demonic Partner
pages.text: As beings of immense powers Demons can have it all ... even love.$(br)In rare cases a Demon is so impressed by a mortal that they stay in touch. And in even rarer cases, take them on a date. And in such cases, the most unlikely thing can happen - $()

pages.title: Demonic Partner
pages.text: love between a Spirit and a mortal.$(br)

pages.title: Demonic Partner
pages.text: Demons, of course, like to deal in contracts, and what better contract than a marriage contract?$(br)Beware however, Spirits are all about commitment, so this is a permanent bond.$(br)

pages.title: Demonic Partner
pages.text: The Demonic Partner - a Husband or Wife - can fight for you and split your household chores.$(br2)Right-Click with any cookable food and they will use their magic to cook it.$(br2)Right-Click with $()

pages.title: Demonic Partner
pages.text: a potion to get the effect for a significantly longer time,$(br) instant potions will be two levels stronger.$(br)

pages.title: Not a Familiar
pages.text: The Demonic Partner Chapter is part of the Familiar Category of this book because of the similarities, however a Partner is obviously not a familiar.$(br2)As such, they also cannot be stored in a $(item)Familiar Ring$(). You can, $()

pages.title: Not a Familiar
pages.text: however, use a $(item)Soul Gem$() as for any other being.$(br)

pages.title: Love is loving
pages.text: A great partner gift is the $(item)Sweet-Honey-Heart$(). To get this item, simply give a $(item)Cursed Honey$() to your husband or wife.$(br2)Note: This action has a cooldown of 10 minutes.$(br)
